narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>In the first puzzle, eigh plus three is six, so eigh is three.
<bookmark mark='b'/>Then B plus seven must end in three, so B is six.
<bookmark mark='test'/>But thirty six plus thirty seven is seventy three, not sixty three.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Six plus seven carries one, and Chintu forgot it.

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, add each answer out and read the digits under every letter.
<bookmark mark='rule'/>Each letter must keep one digit, and different letters must stay different.
